note: PLACEHOLDER MARKET PRICES — replace with real figures in /admin before launch. The site adds FlyRate's profit margin (default 3.5%, editable in /admin) on top of these automatically, same percentage in every direction. All corridors use the divide convention: rate = marketPrice * (1 + margin), calculator divides the sent amount by it (marketPrice = units of FROM currency per 1 unit of TO currency) — this is what makes the reverse corridors 'buy low': student sends MYR/ZAR/SDG, margin pushes the rate up, so they receive less foreign currency than raw market price would give, same mechanic as the forward corridors just mirrored.
